story_texts: Г. П. Палычу — за 100 % сходимость остатков (certificate)
rig_gaps: palych: no seated pose (lowered standing, legs hidden)
kristina: phone prop (st.prop 'phone') did not attach to the hand, so she holds no phone; sticky + ring light carry her trace
vadik standing near the camera uses scale 0.6 from floor y650 to read as 'in front of the table'
3/4 and side views of all rigs look weak: front view is the default, turned views only for rare deliberate shots
hands wider than 1.3x wrist in all three rigs; patched in-set with clipped overlay hands (faint rect edge of the rig drop-shadow may show at 3x zoom)
